samples.summary: The consumer half never lands: the real promote job still has the old `if [ "$code" -eq N ]` chain, so the rewritten workflow-shape test in mark-ready.test.mjs fails against the tree — reddening verify:self on this branch and, once merged, on main and every branch cut from it.
samples.evidence:
.github/workflows/agent-review-panel.yml:1494-1504 is unchanged on this branch:
```
          set +e
          node ./scripts/agent/mark-ready.mjs "$PR" --promote --require-checks "$REQUIRED"
          code=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$code" -eq 2 ]; then ... fi
```
The only copy of the new `case` form is the inert text file docs/tasks/active/20260825-promote-exit-code-default-workflow.patch. But scripts/agent/mark-ready.test.mjs:329-372 now reads that live workflow (PANEL_YML, line 34-36) and asserts `>"$RUNNER_TEMP/mark-ready.log" 2>&1` (:359), `case "$code" in` (:363), the `*)` default (:367-371) and `esac` (:372) — none of which exist at :1494-1504. scripts/verify-self.mjs:160 runs `cd scripts/agent && node --test ... *.test.mjs`, so this is a hard CI failure, and docs/tasks/active/20260825-promote-exit-code-default-todo.md:83-86 confirms it is shipped knowingly red.
Blast radius beyond this PR: the promote job is gated on `needs.ci.outputs.conclusion == 'success'` (:1455) and mark-ready's gate 1 requires the head SHA's "CI" run to be `success` (scripts/agent/mark-ready.mjs:125-138). A red test on main therefore makes CI red on every subsequent agent branch, so no PR — including this one — can ever be promoted until a maintainer applies the patch. Fix belongs on the workflow (apply the patch before merge) or by gating the workflow-shape assertions on the patch's absence.

samples.summary: The new `.patch` file is invisible to the task tooling that owns docs/tasks/active/, so it will be orphaned in `active/` once the todo/lessons pair is archived.
samples.evidence: scripts/tasks-archive.mjs:11 and scripts/tasks-index.mjs:11 both use `^(\d{8})-(.+)-(todo|lessons)\.md$`; a `.patch` file matches neither, so `parseTaskFilename` returns null (tasks-archive.mjs:34-37, tasks-index.mjs:79-82). When the todo's boxes are ticked, `pnpm tasks:archive` moves only the two `.md` files to docs/tasks/archive/YYYY/MM/ (tasks-archive.mjs:103-116) and silently leaves 20260825-promote-exit-code-default-workflow.patch behind in `active/`, referenced by a todo that no longer lives there. docs/tasks/active/README.md:5-6 also documents only the two md shapes. The only thing that removes it is the manual `git rm` in the todo (20260825-promote-exit-code-default-todo.md:80).

samples.summary: A second, stale copy of this suite under `.trusted/` still pins the OLD `-eq N` workflow chain; if that tree is tracked/refreshed, applying the workflow patch makes it assert the opposite of the live workflow.
samples.evidence: .trusted/scripts/agent/mark-ready.test.mjs:256 still reads `assert.match(window, /"\$code" -eq 1 \]; then echo "Not all ready-gates satisfied/, ...)` while scripts/agent/mark-ready.test.mjs:382 now requires the `case` form. `.trusted/` is not listed in .gitignore (no match for `trusted` there), and the panel runs trusted code from that path (.github/workflows/agent-review-panel.yml:873 `node .trusted/scripts/agent/review-panel.mjs`). scripts/verify-self.mjs only runs `scripts/agent/**` and `scripts/test/**`, so it does not execute the stale copy today — hence low confidence — but the two copies now disagree about the promote job's contract.

samples.summary: The hand-off patch is pinned to a specific blob of a 2100-line workflow that other in-flight work also edits, so `git apply` is likely to fail or drift by the time a maintainer runs it.
samples.evidence: The patch header pins `index 5e4a30189..e2f1304ae` and context at `@@ -1492,16 +1492,38 @@` of .github/workflows/agent-review-panel.yml. Another active task plans edits to the same file — docs/tasks/active/20260825-deferred-findings-channel-todo.md:43 ("**`.github/workflows/agent-review-panel.yml`** — two steps"). If that lands first, the line offsets shift and the documented recipe (`git apply docs/tasks/.../*.patch`, todo:79) fails, leaving mark-ready.test.mjs:329 red with no obvious owner. Prefer regenerating the hunk with generous context or landing the workflow change through a credential that holds `Workflows: write` in the same PR.

verdict.reason: Verified in-tree. The promote job at .github/workflows/agent-review-panel.yml:1494-1504 still uses the old `if [ "$code" -eq N ]` chain with no log redirect, no `case "$code" in`, no `*)` default and no `esac`; it is the only mark-ready invocation in any workflow (line 1496), so the test's indexOf window resolves to it. scripts/agent/mark-ready.test.mjs:34-36 reads that live workflow and :359-372 assert the redirect, `case`, `0)/2)/3)` branches, `*)` default and `esac`, plus :377-387 assert a `1)` grep branch — none of which exist. The new form lives only in the unapplied text file docs/tasks/active/20260825-promote-exit-code-default-workflow.patch:15-39. scripts/verify-self.mjs:158-161 runs every scripts/agent/*.test.mjs, so this is a hard CI failure, and the promote job is itself gated on CI success (workflow:1455), extending the breakage to every later agent branch. No guard or skip makes the assertion conditional.
